queueFollowUp.atThirtyMinutes: Record no allocation and apply only the expressly accepted cancellation decision. No retry or replacement dispatch.
queueFollowUp.continuedTracking: The accepted executing operator continues read-only tracking until terminal, even if allocation occurs after the 30-minute bound or a cancellation is refused. Capture late jobs and worker/source bindings; retrieve any resulting artifact before its 30-day expiry and run the same three pinned verifier modes.
queueFollowUp.handoff: A still-queued run remains an open consumed execution. If the session ends, retain its run ID, current status, last observation time, next read-only check and artifact retrieval obligations for the separately accepted monitoring owner; do not silently close or orphan it.
queueFollowUp.noExtraAuthority: Continued GET tracking does not authorize cancellation, rerun, another dispatch or external messages.
